## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

app-wear/build.gradle.kts — the module's Gradle dependency declaration

## Trigger

None — this is a build-time dependency and import gap, not a runtime call. nothing observes it

## Today

app-wear/build.gradle.kts declares `implementation(libs.androidx.compose.material3)` and the phone
`androidx.compose.ui` / `androidx.compose.ui.graphics` artifacts, resolved from the phone Compose
BOM (`libs.androidx.compose.bom`). `gradle/libs.versions.toml` carries no `androidx-wear-compose-*`
entry. No file under `app-wear/src` imports anything from `androidx.wear.compose.*`. Every watch
screen imports `androidx.compose.material3.Text` and lays out with plain `androidx.compose.foundation`
containers: `WatchHistoryScreen.kt`, `ControlScreen.kt`, `PreparationScreen.kt`,
`ProjectionScreen.kt`, `EndOfRaceScreen.kt`, `HomeScreen.kt`, `WaitingForPhoneScreen.kt`,
`MainRacePageScreen.kt` and `SensorPermissionScreen.kt` all use `Column` (mobile), and
`WatchHistoryScreen.kt` uses `androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn` for its list, instead of a
round-screen-aware scrolling container.

## Expected

`gradle/libs.versions.toml` carries a Wear Compose catalogue entry (`androidx.wear.compose:compose-material`
and `androidx.wear.compose:compose-foundation`, matched to a Wear Compose BOM or explicit version), and
`app-wear/build.gradle.kts` depends on it instead of, or alongside, `androidx.compose.material3`. Every
watch screen listed above then draws from `androidx.wear.compose.material.*` (its own `Text`, `Scaffold`)
and `androidx.wear.compose.foundation.lazy.ScalingLazyColumn` in place of `Column`/`LazyColumn`, so
scrolling and list placement follow the round screen. A second gap: each of the nine screens is a
separate migration site once the dependency exists — the catalogue and build-file change alone reaches
none of them; each screen's own composable is out of the bearer's direct reach and has to be touched
individually.
